predecessors.name: Middle Kingdom of Egypt
predecessors.text: the Theban region in Upper Egypt

ledger.x: 1649: the Sixteenth Dynasty rules from Thebes.

c. 1630: war with the Hyksos begins. 'The continuing war against 15th Dynasty dominated the short-lived 16th Dynasty'; 'The armies of the 15th Dynasty, winning town after town'. The year is the Fifteenth Dynasty page's ('after a period of about 20 years since its foundation, extended its rule as far south as Thebes')…

c. 1582: the Sixteenth Dynasty is absorbed. Infobox 'Disestablished: 1582 BC'; Second Intermediate Period page: 'Sometime around 1580 BC, the 16th Dynasty was subsumed after conflict between Thebes and Avaris'. 'eventually threatening and then conquering Thebes itself' is the page's wording; the Seventeenth Dynasty…

c. 1582: the Sixteenth Dynasty gives way to the Seventeenth at Thebes. Infobox 'Disestablished: 1582 BC' and 'Succeeded by Seventeenth Dynasty of Egypt' ('Established: c. 1580 BC' on that page). The Turin canon's last entry is five lost kings, 1588-1582.

wars.name: Hyksos-Theban conflict under the Sixteenth Dynasty
wars.outcome: The Hyksos press the Thebans 'town after town'; the page does not date a battle or a treaty (Ryholt: Dedumose I 'sued for a truce in the latter years of the dynasty'); the dynasty is subsumed c.

certainty.note: Only two limits are named, Hu in the north and Edfu in the south, and only for Nebiriau I's reign; everything else is approximate.
